details: Bitcoin dropped below $72,000 on November 12, marking its lowest point since August. This downturn is attributed to a combination of factors including hotter-than-expected US inflation data, substantial outflows from US spot Bitcoin ETFs (totaling over $1.44 billion between November 5-11), over $650 million in leveraged long position liquidations within 24 hours, and the announced resignation of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, which further impacted market sentiment.
title: Bitcoin Dips Below $72K Amid Macro & Nvidia CEO News

details: Cryptocurrency exchange Gemini has reportedly sold its UK and European business units to KAST, a Singapore-based stablecoin payments company, for less than $10 million. This strategic move follows Gemini's earlier announcement in February to wind down operations in these regions and Australia, alongside a significant reduction in its global workforce.
title: Gemini Sells UK & Europe Operations to KAST

details: Japanese financial services giant Nomura Holdings is reportedly considering the sale of its cryptocurrency subsidiary, Laser Digital. This potential divestment is being weighed due to persistent losses incurred by Nomura's European operations, with preliminary discussions already held with prospective buyers.
title: Nomura May Sell Crypto Unit Laser Digital Amid Losses

details: Several major financial institutions, including Citi, Goldman Sachs, and Deutsche Bank, have collectively committed approximately $270 million to a new stablecoin initiative named Project Faro. The venture plans to launch a USD-denominated stablecoin in the first half of 2027, with ambitions to expand into other G7 currencies thereafter.
title: Banking Giants Commit $270M to Stablecoin Venture Project Faro

details: The broader cryptocurrency market is currently experiencing a notable liquidity drain, evidenced by a significant $14.2 billion contraction in the total stablecoin supply over the past 30 days. This marks the largest decline since 2022 and, combined with ongoing net outflows from U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs, suggests a substantial amount of capital is exiting the digital asset space.
title: Crypto Liquidity Drains as Stablecoin Supply Falls by $14.2B
